name: Ibotenic acid
summary: Ibotenic acid is a psychedelic substance belonging to the 3-Hydroxyisoxazole, Α-Amino acid chemical class.

pharmacology.text: Ibotenic acid acts as a potent agonist of glutamate receptors, including the NMDA receptor and the group I (mGluR1 and mGluR5) and II (mGluR2 and mGluR3) metabotropic glutamate receptors. It is inactive at group III mGluRs. The drug also acts as a weak agonist of the AMPA and kainate receptors. In addition to its actions at glutamate receptors, ibotenic acid acts indirectly as a potent GABAA and GABAA-ρ receptor agonist via metabolism into muscimol.
pharmacology.kind: NMDA receptor agonist; Metabotropic glutamate receptor agonist; GABAA receptor agonist; Neurotoxin; Hallucinogen

uses.text: The compound is used as a brain-lesioning agent in scientific research. Ibotenic acid is commonly used in research to create site-specific hippocampal brain lesions in rats, allowing for task relearning due to its interaction with glutamate receptors, and is favored over other agents for its selectivity and long-term stability in saline solution.
